content.title: Irreversible Craft Variant | One Object Advances to Final Use
content.summary: This is an evidence variant of the existing irreversible cooking state chain. Lock one original clearly adult cook, one kitchen, one dough or base, one tray and visible hand or tool anchors. Move through at least five irreversible food states, one operation per beat, while preserving outline, topping distribution, residue and container continuity. Oven or heat transitions must return the same tray and a plausibly changed version of the same item. End with the same serving and one restrained taste by the same adult. Do not copy source woman, kitchen, pizza, ingredients, recipe, lighting, camera or timing.

quick_start.input_format: Lock one clearly adult original cook, one base material, tray, kitchen and hand anchors. + Apply exactly one irreversible operation per beat. + Preserve outline, residue and topping or component distribution between states. + Return the same tray after heat with plausible color, volume and texture change. + End with the same serving and one restrained taste by the same adult.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open in an original bookbinding studio: one clearly adult binder with green sleeve patch, brass thimble and one stack of cream pages on a blue press board; establish both hands and page edges. Thread the same holes with one red cord, then apply one narrow glue line and close the original gray cover around the same page block; one irreversible operation per visible beat. The same adult lifts the completed book and turns one page under morning light; hold the exact object and hand anchors, with no source woman, pizza, kitchen, ingredients or recipe.
